question: What involuntary vocal effect occurs when the practitioner utters all mantras and mudras?
premises: The practitioner engages all mantras and mudras.
He utters them in a stammering manner.
This occurs as a marked effect.
inference: In this state, he utters the entire group of mantras and mudras in a stammering way.
uncertainties: The compound durdurapluta is interpreted as stammering or faltering utterance.
plain_english: He indeed utters the entire group of mantras and mudras in a stammering manner.
